name: GothHouse
source: You play as a goth futa who is also an elf and partly a crow. Hunted by bad memories and being afraid of overusing her underworld power Darci Nightshade is trying to find her place in the "Avalonian society".
translation: You play as a goth futa who is also an elf and partly a crow. Hunted by bad memories and being afraid of overusing her underworld power Darci Nightshade is trying to find her place in the "Avalonian society".
